title: Vampire Vape Purple Craze Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape’s Purple Craze Ice Nic Salt combines the iconic flavours of two fan-favourite e-liquids: Heisenberg and Pinkman. Purple Craze Ice merges Heisenberg’s cool menthol breeze and aniseed edge with the tangy, ripe red berries and sweet, jammy fruits of Pinkman, adding a more intense icy menthol kick to create a fresh and invigorating vape. This complex and instantly compelling flavour blend offers a perfect balance of rich fruity sweetness and frosty coolness, making it an excellent choice for vapers who love bold, icy flavours. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Purple Craze Ice Nic Salts are crafted for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices and pod kits, delivering a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine relief. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, the nicotine salt formulation ensures faster nicotine absorption, and a smoother vaping experience compared to traditional freebase nicotine, making it ideal for vapers seeking effective nicotine relief.
